text: One menu holds every setting this lesson covers — Refresh, then Schedule refresh, on any semantic model.
Open the workspace, select the semantic model, and that one menu option is where frequency, credentials, and gateway all live.
Turn the schedule on, pick daily or weekly, and add time slots. Each one counts toward the daily quota from Lesson 75.
This section shows which gateway is online and available. If Lesson 76's install isn't online yet, fix that before anything else here matters.
With a personal gateway, you supply credentials once, and they're retained after that.
With a standard gateway, this section is grayed out instead — an admin already configured it centrally.
One quiet trap: two months with no one viewing the report pauses the schedule automatically. Lesson 78 covers this and every other way refresh can fail.
